text: Now for some science that'll blow your mind. Scientists have discovered that the humble Chinese money plant has been hiding a mathematical secret in its leaves this whole time.

speaker: alice
text: They found naturally occurring Voronoi diagrams - those geometric patterns you'd normally see in city planning or computer algorithms - just sitting there in the plant's cellular structure. Nature's been doing advanced mathematics for millions of years and we're only just catching on.

speaker: charlie
text: Plus, researchers finally cracked why the upper atmosphere is cooling while Earth's surface heats up. Carbon dioxide acts like a cosmic radiator up there, which explains one of climate science's weirdest fingerprints.
